front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ
en: over the generations
fr: au fil des générations
ur: نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe knowledge, traditions, or physical changes passed from parents to children over long periods.
example_ar: اِنْتَقَلَتِ القِصَّةُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ.
example_en: The story was passed down over the generations.
related: عَبْرَ الأَزْمَانِ, طِوَالَ التَّارِيخِ

front: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْظِيرِيَّةٍ
en: theoretically / from a theoretical perspective
fr: théoriquement / d'un point de vue théorique
ur: نظریاتی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion to the concepts and rules of a matter, rather than its practical application.
example_ar: هَذَا صَحِيحٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْظِيرِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This is correct from a theoretical perspective.
related: نَظَرِيًّا, اِفْتِرَاضِيًّا

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ القَادِمَةِ
en: over the coming generations
fr: au fil des générations futures
ur: آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase describing the long-term future and the legacy that will be left for children and grandchildren.
example_ar: سَيَبْقَى الأَثَرُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ القَادِمَةِ.
example_en: The impact will remain over the coming generations.
related: طِوَالَ المُسْتَقْبَلِ, لِلأَبْنَاءِ

front: مِنْ قُبَيْلِ الصُّدْفَةِ المَحْضَةِ
en: by pure coincidence / purely accidental
fr: par pure coïncidence / par pur hasard
ur: محض اتفاقاً / بالکل اتفاقیہ
definition_en: Emphatic version of 'min qubayl al-misadafa'. Asserts that an event had absolutely no prior planning or connection.
example_ar: اِلْتَقَيْنَا مِنْ قُبَيْلِ الصُّدْفَةِ المَحْضَةِ.
example_en: We met by pure coincidence.
related: صُدْفَةً تَمَامًا, بِلَا تَرْتِيبٍ

front: عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَنْظِيرِيٍّ مَحْضٍ
en: on a purely theoretical scale
fr: sur un plan purement théorique
ur: خالص نظریاتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that the discussion is entirely academic and has no immediate practical application or testing.
example_ar: نَدْرُسُ القَاعِدَةَ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَنْظِيرِيٍّ مَحْضٍ.
example_en: We study the rule on a purely theoretical scale.
related: فَلْسَفِيًّا, اِفْتِرَاضِيًّا

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المَاضِيَةِ
en: over the past generations
fr: au fil des générations passées
ur: گزشتہ نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe historical trends or traditions inherited from ancestors.
example_ar: تَغَيَّرَتِ القِيَمُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المَاضِيَةِ.
example_en: Values changed over the past generations.
related: طِوَالَ التَّارِيخِ, قَدِيمًا

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُتَعَاقِبَةِ
en: over successive generations
fr: au fil des générations successives
ur: مسلسل آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a chain of inheritance or progress where one generation follows the next without interruption.
example_ar: سَيَنْمُو المَشْرُوعُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُتَعَاقِبَةِ.
example_en: The project will grow over successive generations.
related: عَبْرَ الزَّمَنِ, لِلْأَحْفَادِ

front: عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ
en: on an awareness-raising scale / for public awareness
fr: à l'échelle de la sensibilisation
ur: آگاہی کی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing actions or campaigns designed to inform the public about a specific issue (e.g., health, environment).
example_ar: الحَمْلَةُ تَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ.
example_en: The campaign works on an awareness-raising scale.
related: لِلإِعْلامِ, لِلتَّثْقِيفِ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُتَلَاحِقَةِ
en: over successive and closely-following generations
fr: au fil des générations qui se succèdent rapidement
ur: ایک کے بعد ایک آنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a rapid and continuous succession of generations, often in the context of fast-paced cultural or technological change.
example_ar: تَطَوَّرَتِ التِّكْنُولُوجْيَا عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُتَلَاحِقَةِ.
example_en: Technology evolved over successive and closely-following generations.
related: طِوَالَ السِّنِينَ السَّرِيعَةِ, عَبْرَ الأَزْمَانِ

front: مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُصَادَفَةِ البَحْتَةِ
en: by purely random coincidence / purely by chance
fr: par pur hasard / par coïncidence pure et simple
ur: محض اتفاقاً / بالکل اتفاقیہ
definition_en: Emphatic version of 'min qubayl al-misadafa'. Asserts that there was absolutely no prior plan, intent, or hidden connection.
example_ar: رَأَيْتُهُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُصَادَفَةِ البَحْتَةِ.
example_en: I saw him purely by chance.
related: صُدْفَةً تَمَامًا, بِلَا قَصْدٍ أَبَدًا

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ الغَابِرَةِ
en: over bygone generations / across ancient times
fr: au fil des générations passées / à travers les âges révolus
ur: قدیم نسلوں کے دوران / رفتہ رفتہ گزرتی نسلوں میں
definition_en: Poetic and formal temporal phrase used to describe things that happened in the very distant, almost forgotten past.
example_ar: ضَاعَتِ القِصَصُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ الغَابِرَةِ.
example_en: Stories were lost over bygone generations.
related: قَدِيمًا جِدًّا, فِي الزَّمَنِ البَعِيدِ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ الِاسْتِثْنَائِيَّةِ
en: over exceptional generations
fr: au fil des générations exceptionnelles
ur: غیر معمولی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a specific lineage or era of people who achieved greatness or faced unique challenges.
example_ar: سَيُكْتَبُ التَّارِيخُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ الِاسْتِثْنَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: History will be written over exceptional generations.
related: طِوَالَ العُصُورِ العَظِيمَةِ, خُصُوصًا

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ
en: in the near and tangible foreseeable future
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche et tangible
ur: قریب اور نظر آنے والے (ٹھوس) مستقبل میں
definition_en: Phrase referring to changes that are not only coming soon but will have a physical, observable impact.
example_ar: سَنَرَى التَّحَسُّنَ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ.
example_en: We will see the improvement in the near and tangible foreseeable future.
related: قَرِيبًا جِدًّا, بِشَكْلٍ وَاضِحٍ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْصَرِمَةِ
en: over finished / elapsed generations
fr: au fil des générations passées / révolues
ur: گزری ہوئی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Formal temporal phrase used to describe a continuity that spans generations that have completely finished their time.
example_ar: سَادَ هَذَا الفِكْرُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْصَرِمَةِ.
example_en: This thought prevailed over elapsed generations.
related: طِوَالَ الأَزْمَانِ المَاضِيَةِ, سَابِقًا

front: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِجْتِمَاعِيَّةٍ أَنْتْرُوبُولُوجِيَّةٍ
en: from a socio-anthropological perspective
fr: d'un point de vue socio-anthropologique
ur: سماجی اور بشریاتی (انسانی ارتقاء کے) لحاظ سے
definition_en: Academic phrase narrowing the discussion to the study of human societies, cultures, and their development.
example_ar: هَذِهِ العَادَةُ هَامَّةٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِجْتِمَاعِيَّةٍ أَنْتْرُوبُولُوجِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This custom is important from a socio-anthropological perspective.
related: عِلْمِيًّا, لِدِرَاسَةِ الشُّعُوبِ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْتَصِرَةِ
en: over victorious / triumphant generations
fr: au fil des générations victorieuses
ur: فاتح (کامیاب) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people who have consistently won their battles and maintained their pride.
example_ar: اِزْدَهَرَتِ الدَّوْلَةُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْتَصِرَةِ.
example_en: The state flourished over victorious generations.
related: طِوَالَ سِنِي الفَوْزِ, دَائِمًا

front: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِفْتِصَادِيَّةٍ كُلِّيَّةٍ
en: from a macroeconomic perspective
fr: d'un point de vue macroéconomique
ur: میکرو اکنامک (بڑے پیمانے کے معاشی) لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion to large-scale economic factors like national income, inflation, and growth.
example_ar: البَلَدُ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِفْتِصَادِيَّةٍ كُلِّيَّةٍ.
example_en: The country is fine from a macroeconomic perspective.
related: لِلاِقْتِصَادِ الكَبِيرِ, نَظْرَةٌ شَامِلَةٌ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْهَزِمَةِ لِلأَسَفِ
en: over unfortunately defeated generations
fr: au fil des générations malheureusement vaincues
ur: بدقسمتی سے شکست خوردہ نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a tragic period of history where multiple generations faced loss or colonization.
example_ar: ضَاعَ الحَقُّ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْهَزِمَةِ لِلأَسَفِ.
example_en: The right was lost over unfortunately defeated generations.
related: طِوَالَ سِنِي الخَسَارَةِ, لِلأَسَفِ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْكَسِرَةِ تَمَامًا
en: over completely broken generations
fr: au fil des générations complètement brisées
ur: مکمل طور پر ٹوٹی ہوئی (شکست خوردہ) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people whose spirit, pride, or society has been crushed by long-term oppression or repeated defeat.
example_ar: نُسِيَتِ العِزَّةُ عَلَى مَدَى الجِيالِ المُنْكَسِرَةِ تَمَامًا.
example_en: Glory was forgotten over completely broken generations.
related: طِوَالَ سِنِي الذُّلِّ, لِلأَسَفِ

front: عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ اِجْتِمَاعِيٍّ
en: on a social awareness scale
fr: à une échelle de sensibilisation sociale
ur: سماجی آگاہی (بیداری) کی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing efforts to educate a whole society about a specific problem like health, drugs, or rights.
example_ar: الحَمْلَةُ تَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ اِجْتِمَاعِيٍّ.
example_en: The campaign works on a social awareness scale.
related: لِتَنْبِيهِ النَّاسِ, تَعْلِيمٌ جَمَاعِيٌّ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ
en: for the purpose of winning over / for attraction
fr: à des fins de séduction / pour attirer
ur: مائل کرنے (جیتنے) کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone to join a side, to like a product, or to gain their favor through kindness or persuasion.
example_ar: تَكَلَّمَ بِلُطْفٍ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ.
example_en: He spoke kindly for the purpose of winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ, لِجَذْبِ النَّاسِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفِكْرِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of intellectual winning over / conversion
fr: à des fins de séduction intellectuelle / de conversion
ur: فکری طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone to accept a new philosophy, religion, or political theory through reason.
example_ar: كَتَبَ الكِتَابَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفِكْرِيَّةِ.
example_en: He wrote the book for the purpose of intellectual winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ الثَّقَافِيِّ, لِتَغْيِيرِ الرَّأْيِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of emotional winning over / manipulation
fr: à des fins de séduction émotionnelle / de manipulation
ur: جذباتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to play on someone's feelings (pity, love, or anger) to get them to agree with a point or side.
example_ar: بَكَى بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ.
example_en: He cried for the purpose of emotional winning over.
related: لِلتَّأْثِيرِ النَّفْسِيِّ, لِجَذْبِ القَلْبِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of professional winning over / networking
fr: à des fins de séduction professionnelle / de réseautage
ur: پیشہ ورانہ طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince a colleague, a boss, or a client to support your work or join your business project.
example_ar: أَرْسَلَ السِّيرَةَ الذَّاتِيَّةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ.
example_en: He sent the CV for the purpose of professional winning over.
related: لِكَسْبِ ثِقَةِ الزُّمَلَاءِ, لِلْعَمَلِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفَنِّيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of artistic winning over / aesthetic appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction artistique / d'attrait esthétique
ur: فنی (آرٹسٹک) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince an audience through beauty, style, or creative skill rather than logic.
example_ar: زَيَّنَ الكِتَابَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفَنِّيَّةِ.
example_en: He decorated the book for the purpose of artistic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الذَّوْقِ, لِلْجَمَالِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of diplomatic winning over / lobbying
fr: à des fins de séduction diplomatique / de lobbying
ur: سفارتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince foreign governments or international organizations to support a specific policy or peace plan.
example_ar: زَارَ الوَزِيرُ العَاصِمَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ.
example_en: The minister visited the capital for the purpose of diplomatic winning over.
related: لِكَسْبِ الحُلَفَاءِ, لِلسِّيَاسَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المَنْطِقِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of logical winning over / persuasion
fr: à des fins de séduction logique / de persuasion
ur: منطقی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using cold facts, numbers, and clear reasoning rather than emotion or style.
example_ar: قَدَّمَ الأَدِلَّةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المَنْطِقِيَّةِ.
example_en: He presented evidence for the purpose of logical winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ بِالعَقْلِ, لِلْبُرْهَانِ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الكِلاسِيكِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of classical winning over / traditional appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction classique / d'attrait traditionnel
ur: کلاسیکی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using old-fashioned, high-culture, or traditionally elegant methods (like a formal poem or a handwritten letter).
example_ar: كَتَبَ الرِّسَالَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الكِلاسِيكِيَّةِ.
example_en: He wrote the letter for the purpose of classical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ القُلُوبِ بِالأَدَبِ, لِلْجَمَالِ القَدِيمِ

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ fawran jiddan haalan mutlaqan
en: in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very much immediately absolutely
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche tangible dès maintenant énormément immédiatement absolument
ur: مطلق طور پر اسی وقت فوری طور پر بہت زیادہ محسوس ہونے والے قریب ترین مستقبل میں
definition_en: (Nona-emphatic). Refers to physical results that are absolute, undeniable, and existing with 100% certainty right now.
example_ar: سَيَكُونُ الحَلُّ فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ fawran jiddan haalan mutlaqan.
example_en: The solution will be in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very much immediately absolutely.
related: حَقِيقَةٌ تَامَّةٌ الآنَ, وَاقِعٌ مَفْرُوضٌ

front: بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَبْقَرِيَّةِ
en: for the purpose of genius winning over / brilliant appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction géniale / d'attrait brillant
ur: عبقری (جینیئس) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using a plan so brilliant and complex that it looks like it was created by a genius.
example_ar: صَمَّمَ المَشْرُوعَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَبْقَرِيَّةِ.
example_en: He designed the project for the purpose of genius winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ العُقُولِ الذَّكِيَّةِ, لِلإِبْدَاعِ الفَرِيدِ

front: فِي المَدَى المَنْظُورِ القَرِيبِ المَلْمُوسِ fawran jiddan haalan tamaman mutlaqan
en: in the near foreseeable future tangible right now very much immediately completely absolutely
fr: dans l'avenir prévisible proche tangible dès maintenant énormément immédiatement totalement absolument
